title: OotleAccord
summary: Community milestone escrow with public funding and reviewer approvals. November 11, 2026: two successful mainnet funding transactions match the deployed SapientEscrow component; the live app reads 3.5 of 10 TARI funded. Funding is confirmed, while payout and refund execution were not independently tested. Four demo reviewers share one operator. The retained October recording shows an older testnet checkpoint, not the current mainnet deployment.
cardSummary: Fund milestone escrows and inspect public approvals on Ootle mainnet. Funding activity is confirmed.
creator: SealClubber
